def wrap_by_pixels(s, max_px, renderer, prop):
    lines=[]
    current=""
    for ch in s:
        if ch == "\n":
            lines.append(current); current=""; continue
        trial=current+ch
        w,_,_=renderer.get_text_width_height_descent(trial,prop,ismath=False)
        if current and w > max_px:
            lines.append(current)
            current=ch
        else:
            current=trial
    lines.append(current)
    return "\n".join(lines)
